title: `nvs.exe` carries the logo as its icon and the manifest's facts as its version information, written by the build script itself
scope:
what the Windows binary says about itself to the operating system — its icon, its version
information, which build gets which — and how that is compiled in. An application manifest, a code
signature, and an icon of an author's own on a `nvs build --compile` bundle are not decided here.
